item.skt: A rya gha jha pra tang bhan dha gha tA kang kang brit tsa kha dha yA
item.coloph: zangs mchu dmar po'i gzungs rdzogs so// rgya gar gyi mkhan po dz+nyA na de ba dang / bod kyi ban de chos grub dang / lots+tsha ba b+ha bos bya tshal du bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa'o// //mang+ga laM
